overview: PowerAmp Player is a browser-based virtual music player and advanced audio control system built by Gerrod. It features a Kenwood head unit–style interface with a full audio chain: Memory Commander Chip (3,000 slots), unified BassAmp (Virtual+Digital+Analog+Tube), Virtual Power Converter (120,000W), 6-band EQ, full 6-layer bass system with Epicenter Micro Pro, channel-isolated signal routing, and 7 DIY Kit tiles for self-wired features.
features: Memory Commander Chip with 3,000 memory slots and own dedicated page
Unified BassAmp (Virtual+Digital+Analog+Tube) with 8 ohm dummy load and Virtual RCA jacks
120,000W Virtual Power Converter powering the entire chain
6-band EQ as command layer (BASS, LOW MID, VOCALS, MID, HIGH MID, TREBLE)
6-layer bass system with Epicenter Micro Pro, Cheater Beater, E-Quake, Soul Mode
Protection system (3 sliders: Distortion Clean, Clipping Control, Particle Breakdown)
Mids and Highs isolated on browser layer with bass blocker fuses
Commander bass block gatekeeper and page-level chat block
7 DIY Kit tiles with auto-wiring (tap to confirm wire-in)
Universal Restore App Testing with auto-disconnect
Cinematic Credits/Story with voice narration and centered text
Kenwood-style head unit UI with blue+gold metallic theme
